info.name: Momna Java PR29 Network HTTP E2E
info.description: Network-level checks against the real Java Spring Boot process in a disposable PostgreSQL environment. The contract-surface group probes every operation in the repository OpenAPI inventory; protected routes deliberately assert unauthenticated denial because this isolated environment has no configured email delivery or external identity provider. Safety business rules are covered by Java tests, not claimed as exercised by these unauthenticated requests. Includes six authenticated R17 pressure-rule scenarios using short-lived seeded accounts in the disposable E2E database. No test credential is accepted by production or added as an application endpoint.

exec: pm.test('readiness does not expose credentials', function () { var t = pm.response.text().toLowerCase(); ['jdbc:','postgresql://','password=','secret-access-key'].forEach(function (x) { pm.expect(t).not.to.include(x); }); });
